name: list-filters
title: List with filters
description: A screen of many records of one type: a header, filters directly above the data, and pagination below it on the trailing side.

meta.useWhen: Users scan, search, and filter many records of one type, such as customers, orders or an audit log.
meta.avoidWhen: Users read one record at a time beside the list: use list-detail. Users watch several measures at a glance: use dashboard.

regions.header: One page-header: the title and the page's one primary action
regions.filters: filter-bar, search first; more than four filters collapse into a popover
regions.data: A table or a list of cards, rendering empty, loading, error and long
regions.pagination: pagination, past 50 rows, on the trailing side

data.loading: boolean: sets aria-busy on the data region
